description:
Future Talent: Data Scientist / Lead Data Scientist - AI (Talent Community – India) 
 Location: Bengaluru
 Position Type: Future Opening - Talent Pipeline

 The Opportunity 
 We are continuously searching for exceptional Data Scientists and AI Specialists across India to help us build innovative AI-powered solutions that transform financial markets and empower decision-making at scale.
 While we may not have an immediate opening today, this dedicated Data Science & AI Talent Community allows us to engage with high-calibre professionals early and connect them with future opportunities as our teams grow. Candidates in our talent community may be considered for Data Scientist, Senior Data Scientist, and Lead Data Scientist opportunities aligned to their skills and experience.
 By joining our AI talent network, you'll gain insight into our engineering culture, AI innovation strategy, and future opportunities while positioning yourself for accelerated consideration when relevant roles become available.

 What You'll Do (When You Join Us) 
 As a Data Scientist, you will work on high-impact AI and machine learning solutions that move beyond experimentation into scalable production environments.
 Build AI Solutions 
 Develop and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning solutions using modern Generative AI technologies such as OpenAI, Gemini, and other advanced LLM platforms.
 Design data-driven models that solve complex business and customer challenges.
 Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to extract insights from large-scale datasets.
 Optimize & Innovate 
 Tune, evaluate, and enhance AI models to improve accuracy, scalability, efficiency, and business impact.
 Assess emerging AI technologies and third-party solutions against functional and non-functional requirements.
 Establish and maintain strong model evaluation, monitoring, and governance standards.
 Collaborate 
 Partner closely with engineering, product, business, and research teams to define AI roadmaps and deliver measurable outcomes.
 Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Contribute to solution design discussions and best-practice initiatives across teams.
 Lead & Grow 
 Drive technical excellence through coding standards, model governance, and knowledge sharing.
 Mentor peers and contribute to data science communities, innovation forums, and technical discussions.
 Support the adoption of modern AI engineering and MLOps practices.
 
 What You'll Bring 
 Technical Expertise 
 Strong experience applying Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI techniques to real-world business problems.
 Proficiency in Python and modern data science libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-Learn.
 Expertise working with cloud platforms such as Azure and/or AWS.
 Strong statistical modelling, data analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.
 Experience deploying AI/ML models into production environments.
 Engineering Excellence 
 Understanding of software engineering principles and maintainable code practices.
 Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, model deployment, testing, and monitoring practices.
 Ability to balance innovation with scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
 
 Ways of Working 
 Build With Purpose – Start with why. Focus on outcomes and measurable impact.
 Customer Driven – Work backwards from customer needs and feedback.
 Technically Courageous – Solve difficult problems and challenge conventional thinking.
 Learn and Be Curious – Continuously explore emerging technologies and AI advancements.
 Act as Owner – Take accountability for long-term value creation.
 Lead with Data – Use evidence and insights to drive decision-making.
 Collaborate to Achieve – Work inclusively across disciplines and teams.
 
 How We Hire 
 Our hiring process is skills-focused and designed to be fair, objective, and consistent. Depending on the role level, candidates may participate in technical assessments and interview stages evaluating:
 Data Science and Machine Learning fundamentals
 Python programming and problem-solving skills
 AI / Generative AI expertise
 Applied business problem solving
 Communication and stakeholder management
 Alignment with our engineering principles and values
 
 Why Connect Now? 
 Skip the Line 
 Candidates in this talent community may receive priority consideration when suitable Data Science and AI opportunities become available.
 Exclusive Insights 
 Gain visibility into our AI innovation initiatives, engineering events, and technical community discussions.
 Career Alignment 
 We will connect with you regarding opportunities that align with your interests, whether in Machine Learning, Generative AI, MLOps, NLP, Data Science, Applied AI, or AI Platform Engineering.

 How to Join 
 Upload your CV along with a brief note describing:
 The Data Science or AI challenges you enjoy solving.
 Areas of interest such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, MLOps, Data Engineering, or AI Platform Development.
 Preferred location and career aspirations.
 We will review your profile and connect when opportunities align with your skills and interests.

 
 What you’ll get in return 
 High-impact projects : We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve complex, high-value challenges.
 Competitive benefits : You will enjoy a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development.
 Industry leadership : This is an opportunity to be a founding member of the organization that’s delivering brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions.
 Collaborative environment : We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams.

 We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘Blended’, which requires attending the office at least three day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently.


 We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25 

 
 Career Stage: 
Manager 
 London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 
 Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
 
 Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership , Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
 
 Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
 
 We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
 
 You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
 
 LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
 
 Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject . 
 
 If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.
